The epitope of Fab IOMA on HIV-1 Env gp120 was determined from the structure of a complex of antibodies Fab 10-1074 and Fab IOMA bound to glycosylated Env gp120/gp41 trimer antigen (BG505 SOSIP.664 gp140), solved by molecular replacement. The Env gp120/gp41 trimer is engineered to form a stable, soluble, pre-fusion closed trimer. The construct contains a disulfide bond (SOS) to covalently link gp120 and gp41, isoleucine to proline mutation (IP), truncation after residue 664 in gp41 to remove the membrane proximal external region and other modifications. The Env construct prepared from human cells contains high mannose and complex-type glycans. The IOMA–10-1074–BG505 structures revealed an Env trimer bound to three 10-1074 and three IOMA Fabs. 19 N-glycans (one GlcNAc up to complex-type tetra-antennary) were visible per gp120–gp41 protomer, forming arrays of glycans extending ~30 Å from the trimer surface.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 3.9 angstroms

The structure of epitope-specific antibody CH235.9 bound to the HIV-1 Env trimer was determined by negative stain EM. The 3-D reconstructions of Fabs CH235, CH235.9 and CH235.12 bound to trimeric BG505 and B41 HIV-1 Env glycoprotein showed that the stoichiometry increased with antibody maturation. CH235 bound with a stoichiometry of 1:1 or 2:1 Fabs per trimer and CH235.9 and CH235.12 bound stoichiometry of 3:1 Fab to trimer ratio.

The epitope-specific antibody CH235.9 was tested by ELISA for binding to 113 recombinant CH505 gp120 Env isolated from time of transmission to week 160 post-transmission, including CH505 TF loop D mutant Envs and 15 heterologous gp120 Envs. Of note, CH235.9 and CH235.12 bound to 4/22 and 8/22 Envs isolated from week 136 and 160 post-transmission, respectively. The affinity of epitope-specific antibody CH235 lineage for binding to HIV-1 CH505 TF Env increased four orders of magnitude during affinity maturation, as determined by surface plasmon resonance.

The epitope of E51 Fab on the HIV-1 Env gp120 was determined by single-particle cryo-electron microscopy reconstruction at 3.3 Å resolution of the structure of E51 Fab bound to the complex of fully open BG505 SOSIP.664 gp120/gp41 Env trimer bound to soluble CD4 domains 1 and 2 (D1D2). Fab E51 contained two sulfotyrosine residues. An asymmetric Env trimer complexed with three sCD4s and three E51 Fabs and exhibited two distinct conformations referred to here as class I and class II. The class I and class II Env trimers are distinguished by containing different proportions of two distinct gp120–gp41 protomer conformations, defined by differences in the gp120 core (gp120 residues excluding V1V2 and V3) and in gp41. The class I Env trimer contained two protomers in conformation A and one protomer in conformation B (AAB trimer), whereas the class II Env trimer contained one protomer in conformation A and two protomers in conformation B (ABB trimer). This structure describes conformational class I.

The epitope of scFv VRC01 on HIV-1 Env gp120 was determined from the structure of a complex of antibodies scFv VRC01, Fab PGT122 and Fab 35O22 bound to glycosylated Env gp120/gp41 trimer antigen (clade G X1193.c1 SOSIP.664 gp140), solved by molecular replacement. The Env gp120/gp41 trimer is engineered to form a stable, soluble, pre-fusion closed trimer. The construct contains a disulfide bond (SOS) to covalently link gp120 and gp41, isoleucine to proline mutation (IP), truncation at residue 665 in gp41 to remove the membrane proximal external region and other modifications. Mutation A60C in the VRC01 heavy chain and G459C in HIV-1 gp120 allows for formation of a disulfide bond at the antibody-Env interface. The Env construct expressed in GnTT cells and purified contained high mannose glycans.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 3.11 angstroms

The epitope of VRC01(GL) Fab on the HIV-1 gp120 core was determined from the crystal structure of the complex, solved by molecular replacement. The HIV-1 426c gp120 monomeric core construct is a modified version of the clade C 426c Env containing all wild-type N-linked glycosylation sites (NLGSs) (including those at positions Asn276, Asn460, and Asn463), but lacks variable loops 1, 2, and 3.
